items.item_text: Successful completion of Certified Nursing Assistant program.
California Certified Nursing Assistant: CA CNA, upon hire
Basic Life Support - BLS, upon hire
High School GED or High School Graduate
Six (6) months recent long term care facility experience as CNA

Performs and educates familiy members, as indicated, the restorative care functions that may include, but are not necessarily be limited to: 1) Ambulation assistance 2) Eating assistance 3) ADL assistance 4) ROM (AROM & PROM) 5) Bowel & Bladder Training 6) Splint / Brace / Prosthesis placement / care. Performs the above duties as well as lifting, moving, positioning and transporting of patients while using proper techniques and/or equipment. Measurements: Observation, Feedback, Equipment condition, Variance reports

In addition to those listed in 1.1 above, demonstrates basic skills including, but not necessarily limited to: Patient hygiene (bathing, grooming, oral and perineal care, back rubs); Documentation of baseline data (vital signs, intake and output), Knowledge of mobility and precautions for orthopedic patients; Skin care for immobilized patients; Infection control & prevention. Measurements: Observation, Feedback, Chart documentation
Reports pertinent information to appropriate person(s) / positions, including information needed for IDT / Care Planning conferences. Measurements: Documentation, Feedback.
Participates in continuing education in areas applicable to position and the patient population. Measurements: Education records.
Demonstrates understanding of resident's rights; maintains an environment free of abuse, and reports suspected resident abuse to supervisor. Measurements: Observation, Feedback.

Provides for resident and staff safety through application of safety guidelines, including infection control and prevention guidelines / policies. Measurements: Observation, Feedback, Equipment condition, Variance reports.
